name: Vokány (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner divided by a downward-pointing chevron into a white upper part and a yellow lower part, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Vokány (a shield of blue and green with a bunch of grapes and a church, with red and green mantling) above a scroll inscribed VOKÁNY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Vokány arms with mantling and scroll
